svg.title: Unlimited transmission layout
svg.desc: Envelope of the hf transmission of Hi: tune tone, sync train, START, package 0 (0x48), STOP = START, package 1 (0x69), STOP, END and tail, with the bit of every data slot.
svg.text: Transmission layout: “Hi” with the hf preset
Real Encoder output: T 16 ms, N 8 bits per package, pitch 1500 Hz; 44 slots + 100 ms tail = 804 ms.
“Hi” = 0x48 0x69 = 01001000 01101001, most significant bit first: one byte per package. No lead-in on the HF presets.
The last sync marker is the START of package 0; every STOP is the START of the next package; END is 2 markers after the last STOP.
The receiver measures T on the sync train and N from the first START-to-STOP span: 9 slots = 8 bits + STOP (spec 3.8).
